relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, in vitro treatment with morphine enhances nociceptor sensitization by the subsequent exposure to PGE2.

relationships.evidence_quote: treatment of nociceptors with morphine, in vitro, produces a leftward shift in the concentration dependence for PGE<sub>2</sub>-induced nociceptor sensitization

key_findings: Brief in vitro morphine exposure of cultured DRG nociceptors causes a leftward shift in PGE2-induced rheobase reduction, a full in vitro model of opioid-induced hyperalgesic priming.
